name: Play it again
author: Bob
description: Removes albums from your Play Later playlist once you've listened to enough tracks. Also maintains a Forgotten Records playlist of random complete albums you haven't played in a while.

subsonicAPI.reason: Read and modify the Play Later and Forgotten Records playlists

users.reason: Receive scrobble events per user and iterate users for scheduled rebuilds

kvstore.reason: Track per-user played-track counts between sessions

cache.reason: Cache playlist IDs to avoid redundant API calls

scheduler.reason: Schedule periodic rebuild of the Forgotten Records playlist

playlist_name.title: Play Later Playlist Name
playlist_name.description: Exact name of the existing 'Play Later' playlist to watch (case-insensitive).

threshold.title: Album Removal Threshold (%)
threshold.description: Percentage of distinct album tracks that must be scrobbled before the album is removed from the Play Later playlist (1–100).

fr_playlist_name.title: Forgotten Records Playlist Name
fr_playlist_name.description: Name of the Forgotten Records playlist (case-insensitive). Created automatically if it doesn't exist.

fr_album_count.title: Albums per Rebuild
fr_album_count.description: Number of complete albums to include in the Forgotten Records playlist.

fr_pool_multiplier.title: Pool Multiplier
fr_pool_multiplier.description: Size of the candidate pool as a multiple of Albums per Rebuild. E.g. 8 albums × multiplier 10 = 80 least-recently-played albums form the pool, 8 are randomly selected.

fr_threshold.title: Album Removal Threshold (%)
fr_threshold.description: Percentage of distinct album tracks that must be scrobbled before the album is removed from Forgotten Records playlist(1–100).

fr_update_schedule.title: Rebuild Schedule (Cron)
fr_update_schedule.description: Cron expression for how often the Forgotten Records playlist is rebuilt. Default: daily at midnight (0 0 * * *). Requires Navidrome restart to take effect.

fr_refresh_now.title: Refresh Forgotten Records Now
fr_refresh_now.description: Enable this and play any track to trigger an immediate rebuild of the Forgotten Records playlist. The rebuild runs shortly after your next scrobble. Disable afterwards to avoid repeated rebuilds.

logging.title: Enable Logging
logging.description: Write plugin activity to the KVStore log buffer. Read with the Python snippet in README.md.
